title: Cut the Windows startup cost of the committed-input reader's recursive submodule status without weakening its checks
outcome: Cut the Windows startup cost of the committed-input reader's recursive submodule status without weakening its checks
acceptance: A recorded per-call timing on Windows Central shows where the reader's time goes, before and after, on a no-submodule fixture and on a repository with initialized nested submodules

The reader's verdicts are unchanged across the shared fixture table, including a gitlink without a .gitmodules mapping (still refused), off-pin, uninitialized and nested children, and no full file or index listing is added
If no safe faster route exists, the item records that measured conclusion and the existing recursive call stays
